Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for taking time last week. Per our call, attached is a short SOW for a 6-week proof-of-concept focused on cost visibility and tagging hygiene across your hosted and dedicated fleets (attached: Nimbus_SOW_v1.pdf). High-level scope: 

- Week 0: Kickoff & data access (Cloud billing exports, tagging report, sample traces)
- Weeks 1-3: Ingest + normalization; dashboarding for per-team cost & spike detection
- Weeks 4-5: Recommendations engine tuning & runbook integration (Slack alerts + Redwood Console hooks)
- Week 6: Handoff, knowledge transfer, and a short exec demo

Estimated list price: $48,000 for the PoC (includes up to 3 data connectors and up to 5 stakeholders on the pilot). We can offer a 15% pilot discount if Redwood will commit to a six-month paid pilot if outcomes align.

Questions for you before we lock dates:
1) Who will be the technical point of contact for cloud billing access?
2) Any compliance constraints (data residency/SOC2 evidence) we should account for during the pilot?
3) Preferred week to start (we have capacity starting May 25 and June 8).

I've attached a short data-spec sheet as well. Happy to jump on a 30-minute scoping call this week.

Best,
Jennifer Park
Head of Solutions
NimbusFinOps
--
